items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 1 of your scored meals, but that's too few to see how it affects you yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, with dinners from 8-9 pm having the biggest effect. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference for you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You typically fast for 10.8 hours overnight, which is less than the 13 hours that might be helpful. Adding an overnight fast to your routine might be something to try, but it's not clear yet if it will make a difference for you.
